replacements.label: preserve OURS' per-model icon override additively. Upstream models the icon per PROVIDER (icon()); ours had LanguageModel::icon() as a trait method, overridden once (OpenCode: GLM -> Zhipu). A new defaulted hook widens the provider's view to the model, so no upstream provider is affected until it opts in.
new: /// Upstream models the icon per *provider* (`icon()` above). Our providers
/// need to vary it per *model* -- OpenCode's GLM models show the Zhipu icon
/// rather than the provider's own -- so this hook widens the provider's view
/// to the model it is being asked about. It defaults to `icon()`, so every
/// upstream provider is unaffected until it opts in.
